- Innovation scanning

System 5 - Training Policy 🎭

- Animal welfare

Metasystem Integration:
- Balance discipline and play
- Harmonize pet and family needs
- Adapt to individual pets

Training Approach:

2. Coordinate training elements (S2)
3. Implement routines (S1)

- Recursively effective (build systematically)
- Adaptively personalized (match pet personality)

Maintain homeostasis between training goals and animal welfare while ensuring effective pet development.
